ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35% high-intensity white pixels to 65% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, high-contrast white contiguous patches located on the distal half of both lobes. Left lobe features a broad, triangular white region. Right lobe features a more fragmented white region with significant dark mottling and internal spotting.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, with more irregular peak heights on the inner-lobe margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular white spots and ring-like pixel groups (barnacle scars) concentrated along the trailing edges and within the lower-right dark region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible within the dark central region of the fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe distal to the median notch; extensive circular scarring on both lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy mottling within the white patches on the right lobe creating a complex, non-solid intensity map compared to the left lobe.
